text: Thanks Sam. Now in tennis news, the French Open has been turned on its head with world number one Jannik Sinner knocked out in the second round. The Italian appeared to be struggling with the heat at Roland Garros and just couldn't find his rhythm against a determined opponent.

speaker: alice
text: That's opened up the men's draw completely Alex. Sometimes these upsets remind us why we love sport - on any given day, anyone can beat anyone if they bring their A-game and a bit of luck goes their way.

speaker: charlie
text: Couldn't agree more Jamie. And looking ahead, our State of Origin boys are gearing up for Game One yesterday in Sydney. NSW and Queensland are both confident about their chances, which means we're in for an absolute cracker of a series.
